acceptance: No final A-pass/C-fail pairs and either more final C passes or equal passes plus fewer C live repair requests. Elapsed is observational, not a robust speed gate. Only qualifies for independent task/changed-correct-candidate validation, not adoption.
limits: Three previously developed helper tasks, actual original-agent generation SYS. Fresh requests are producer-transfer development evidence, not unseen-task blind validation.
Exactly one initial request per task; all initial replies and full request payloads fixed before paired workers. No resampling even if identical to old text or no C trigger.
Both workers replay the exact actual initial response once; their entire initial request object must equal real generation request. Replays are not real model calls.

Original runtime22e322 and skills byte-identical. Private process only hooks extraction/request observation and captures ordinary xvlog stdout/source without changing return behavior. No shared service/production files modified.
Live repairs preserve original one-repair budget and prompts. Experiment caps HTTP at120s versus original300; actual max3 initial+6 repairs=9, stage1800/outer2100/lease2400 seconds.

Controls calibrate first; all six workers finish before experimental final grades. TB/ref/grades never enter model requests or C decisions. Events bind response/source/manifest hashes and phase order.
C only keeps reply-existing helper modules and exact original Top bytes, candidate-only source diagnostics/warning fallback; compilation is not semantic proof.
Adder16/32 finite domains remain partial; no architecture/four-state/hidden test certification or weighted official score. No new synthesis/MCP.

Report common initial model elapsed once per inferred arm path plus supervised worker time; actual experiment wallclock only generates initial replies once. HTTP service ingress/serialization cost not measured; shared prefix cache/order variance not controlled.
Separate A-final-correct/C-changed guards from A-final-correct/C-unchanged. Zero regression without changed-correct natural denominator cannot support deployment.
Dual cooperative shared locks and owned directories; do not touch foreign locks/processes or restart shared model/instance.
